FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 567
Committee: Education Policy Sponsor: Representative Jeremy Gray
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 03/17/2026
House Bill 567 as introduced would increase the administrative obligations of the State
Department of Education to: (1) develop guidelines to implement the provisions of this bill
regarding student athletes; (2) monitor compliance and to gather data from local schools in the
state; and (3) provide an annual report to the State Board of Education and the chairs of the
Education Policy committees in the Senate and the House of Representatives.
This bill would also increase the administrative obligations of the local boards of education to
implement the required tracking of student athletes, designate a staff member to oversee the
local program, and to provide updates to student athletes and their families.
